spans.s: गह् vt. or vi. 10U (pres. गहयति-ते) 1. To be thick or impervious (as a forest); 2. to enter deeply into.

गाह् vt. 1Ā (pp. गाढ or गाहित) 1. To dive into, to bathe, to plunge into, गाहंतां महिषा निपानसलिलं शृंगैर्मुहुस्ताडितम् Sak.ii., जगाहिरेऽंबुधि नागाः Bt.xiv.67; 2. to penetrate, to enter deeply into, to roam, to range, ऊनं न सत्वेष्वधिको बबाधे तस्मिन्वनं गोप्तरि गाहमाने R.ii.14, छायया गाहमानः Megh.i.48; 3. to be absorbed in; 4. to entertain, मनस्तु मे संशयमेव गाहते K.S.v.46; 5. to churn, to stir, to agitate; 6. to destroy.With अव-, (sometimes changed into व, पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी वगाह्य K.S.i.1) 1. to penetrate into, to enter, K.S.i.1; 2. to plunge into, to bathe, स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेऽत्यर्थं जलम् Yaj.i.272.With उप-, to break in.With वि-, 1. to plunge into, to bathe in, तमसां विगाह्य R.xiv.76, xix.9; 2. to agitate or stir about, विगाह्यमानां सरयूं च नौभिः R.xiv.30; 3. to enter, to pervade, to penetrate into, R.xiii.1.With सम्-, to enter, to penetrate into, to go to, समगाहिष्ट चांबरम् Bt.xv.59.

गहन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Deep, dense, thick, impenetrable; 2. inexplicable, hard to be understood, अहह गहनो मोहमहिमा Sant.S.i.8, सेवाधर्मः परमगहनो योगिनामप्यगम्यः Bhartr.ii.58; 3. inaccessible; 4. causing pain or distress, संसारोऽयं महानसो गहनः Sant.S.iii.15.
गहन (II) n. 1. A wood, a thicket, a forest, Bh.V.i.25; 2. a hiding place; 3. a cave; 4. pain, distress.

गहन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Deep, dense, thick, impenetrable; 2. inexplicable, hard to be understood, अहह गहनो मोहमहिमा Sant.S.i.8, सेवाधर्मः परमगहनो योगिनामप्यगम्यः Bhartr.ii.58; 3. inaccessible; 4. causing pain or distress, संसारोऽयं महानसो गहनः Sant.S.iii.15.
गाहन n. The act of diving into, bathing &c.
गह्वर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Deep, impervious.

गह्वर (II) n. 1. An abyss, a depth; 2. a thicket, a forest; 3. a cave, a cavern, गौरीगुरोर्गह्वरमाविवेश R.ii.26, ii.46, Rt.i.21; 4. a riddle; 5. hypocrisy^1; 6. weeping, crying; 7. a place difficult of access.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260516. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/224.
गह्वर (III) m. An arbour, a bower.
गह्वर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Deep, impervious.
गह्वर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Deep, impervious.
गह्वरी f. A cave, a cavern, a recess in a rock.
गाह m. 1. Diving into, plunging, bathing; 2. depth, interior.
गाहित a. (f. ता) 1. Bathed, plunged; 2. penetrated, searched about, गाहितमखिलं गहनम् Bh.i.21, (pp. of गाह् q.v.).
गाहित a. (f. ता) 1. Bathed, plunged; 2. penetrated, searched about, गाहितमखिलं गहनम् Bh.i.21, (pp. of गाह् q.v.).
